"''Jezzi and Femmi brought supper and Maarva's medicine, and then Jezzi came back b-b-because…''"
"''Anybody looking for me?|Cassian Andor and B2EMO|{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}}}} One [[Standard day|night]] in [[5 BBY]], '''Femmi''' and [[Jezzi]] bought medicine for the elderly [[human]] [[Maarva Carassi Andor|Maarva Andor]] and [[Foodstuff|supper]] to the [[Andor household]] on the [[planet]]{{Andor|Nobody's Listening!}} [[Ferrix]]. [[Cassian Jeron Andor|Cassian Andor]], Maarva's adopted son, had been out when Femmi and Jezzi visited, and the next day he questioned the family [[droid]] [[B2EMO]] as to who had visited while he was out. The droid then mentioned that Femmi had visited with Jezzi. {{Char-stub}} ==Behind the scenes== Femmi was mentioned in [[Kassa (episode)|first episode]] of the television series ''[[Star Wars: Andor]]'', which aired on [[September 21]], [[2022]].{{SWYouTube|cKOegEuCcfw|Andor | Official Trailer | Disney+ (2:25)|sw_url=video/andor-official-trailer}} ==Appearances== *{{Andor|Kassa (episode)}} {{1stm}} *{{Andor|That Would Be Me}} {{Mo}} ==Notes and references== {{Reflist}} {{Interlang |de=Femmi |es=Femmi |fr=Femmi |ja=フェミ |ka=ფემი |nl=Femmi |pl=Femmi}} [[Category:Females]] [[Category:Ferrixians]] [[Category:Individuals of unspecified species]]
